module: Gameplay selector tile generator for scenarios (legacy system). It adds one tile per scenario returned by scenario_scenariosLoader.getList and builds the details panel with a "Start Scenario" button. Local multiplayer scenarios are classified in the scenariosMultiplayer system.
notes: Tiles are only added for the gameplaySelector backend. The "More Scenarios..." tile is commented out in the code and therefore does not exist.
The details always display "Scenario system is outdated." (legacy system).
The specifications include difficulty, authors, date, map, number of local players, objectives (goals) and additional attributes.

onGameplaySelectorGetTiles.desc: Hook called when the selector collects its tiles. For the gameplaySelector backend, adds one tile per scenario (translated name, preview, level, key scenario_<sourceFile>). A scenario whose playersCountRange.max exceeds 1 gets the helmets icon and the scenarioMultiplayer type; the beamNG and bug icons flag official and auxiliary scenarios.

items.desc: List of tiles to complete (modified in place).

onGameplaySelectorGetDetails.desc: Hook called when a tile's details are opened. If itemDetails.scenarioSourceFile exists, loads the scenario and adds to details a block (title, description, preview, favorite, specifications, official, auxiliary, multiplayer, mod labels) with a "Start Scenario" button that records the item as recent and then calls scenario_scenariosLoader.start.

details.desc: List of details blocks to complete.
